verses.original: Ὅσοι εἰσὶν ὑπὸ ζυγὸν δοῦλοι ἡγείσθωσαν τοὺς ἰδίους δεσπότας πάσης ἀξίους τιμῆς ἵνα τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ ὄνομα καὶ ἡ διδασκαλία μὴ βλασφημῆται
verses.transliteration: Hosoi eisin hypo zygon douloi hēgeisthōsan tous idious despotas pasēs axious timēs hina tou Theou to onoma kai hē didaskalia mē blasphēmētai
verses.literal: All who are under [the] yoke of slavery should regard [their] . . . masters {as} fully worthy of honor so that - God’s - name and [our] teaching vvv will not be discredited

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἔχοντες πιστοὺς δεσπότας μὴ καταφρονείτωσαν ὅτι εἰσιν ἀδελφοί ἀλλὰ δουλευέτωσαν μᾶλλον ὅτι οἱ ἀντιλαμβανόμενοι τῆς εὐεργεσίας εἰσιν καὶ ἀγαπητοὶ πιστοί δίδασκε καὶ παρακάλει Ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: de hoi echontes pistous despotas mē kataphroneitōsan hoti eisin adelphoi alla douleuetōsan mallon hoti hoi antilambanomenoi tēs euergesias eisin kai agapētoi pistoi didaske kai parakalei Tauta
verses.literal: - Those who have believing masters vvv should not show disrespect because they are brothers but should serve [them] all the more since those receiving [their] good service are - beloved believers Teach and encourage these [principles]

verses.original: Εἴ τις ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖ καὶ μὴ προσέρχεται ὑγιαίνουσιν λόγοις τοῖς ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ τῇ κατ’ εὐσέβειαν διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Ei tis heterodidaskalei kai mē proserchetai hygiainousin logois tois hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kai tē kat’ eusebeian didaskalia
verses.literal: If anyone teaches another doctrine and vvv disagrees [with the] sound words - of our - Lord Jesus Christ and - with godly teaching

verses.original: τετύφωται ἐπιστάμενος μηδὲν ἀλλὰ νοσῶν περὶ ζητήσεις καὶ λογομαχίας ἐξ ὧν γίνεται φθόνος ἔρις βλασφημίαι πονηραί ὑπόνοιαι
verses.transliteration: tetyphōtai epistamenos mēden alla nosōn peri zētēseis kai logomachias ex hōn ginetai phthonos eris blasphēmiai ponērai hyponoiai
verses.literal: he is conceited [and] understands nothing Instead [he has] an unhealthy interest in controversies and disputes about words out of which come envy strife abusive talk evil suspicions

verses.original: διαπαρατριβαὶ ἀνθρώπων διεφθαρμένων τὸν νοῦν καὶ ἀπεστερημένων τῆς ἀληθείας νομιζόντων τὴν εὐσέβειαν εἶναι πορισμὸν
verses.transliteration: diaparatribai anthrōpōn diephtharmenōn ton noun kai apesterēmenōn tēs alētheias nomizontōn tēn eusebeian einai porismon
verses.literal: [and] constant friction between men of depraved - mind [who are] devoid - of the truth [These men] regard - godliness as a means of gain

verses.original: δὲ ἡ εὐσέβεια μετὰ αὐταρκείας Ἔστιν μέγας πορισμὸς
verses.transliteration: de hē eusebeia meta autarkeias Estin megas porismos
verses.literal: Of course - godliness with contentment is great gain

verses.original: γὰρ εἰσηνέγκαμεν οὐδὲν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὅτι οὐδὲ δυνάμεθα ἐξενεγκεῖν τι
verses.transliteration: gar eisēnenkamen ouden eis ton kosmon hoti oude dynametha exenenkein ti
verses.literal: For we brought nothing into the world so vvv we cannot carry anything {out of it}

verses.original: δὲ ἔχοντες διατροφὰς καὶ σκεπάσματα ἀρκεσθησόμεθα τούτοις
verses.transliteration: de echontes diatrophas kai skepasmata arkesthēsometha toutois
verses.literal: But if we have food and clothing we will be content with these

verses.original: Οἱ βουλόμενοι πλουτεῖν δὲ ἐμπίπτουσιν εἰς πειρασμὸν καὶ παγίδα καὶ πολλὰς ἀνοήτους καὶ βλαβεράς ἐπιθυμίας αἵτινες βυθίζουσιν τοὺς ἀνθρώπους εἰς ὄλεθρον καὶ ἀπώλειαν
verses.transliteration: Hoi boulomenoi ploutein de empiptousin eis peirasmon kai pagida kai pollas anoētous kai blaberas epithymias haitines bythizousin tous anthrōpous eis olethron kai apōleian
verses.literal: Those who want to be rich however fall into temptation and become ensnared - by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge - [them] into ruin and destruction

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ φιλαργυρία ἐστιν ῥίζα πάντων τῶν κακῶν ὀρεγόμενοι ἧς τινες ἀπεπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς πίστεως καὶ περιέπειραν ἑαυτοὺς πολλαῖς ὀδύναις
verses.transliteration: gar hē philargyria estin rhiza pantōn tōn kakōn oregomenoi hēs tines apeplanēthēsan apo tēs pisteōs kai periepeiran heautous pollais odynais
verses.literal: For the love of money is [the] root of all kinds - of evil By craving [it] some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows

verses.original: δέ Σὺ ὦ ἄνθρωπε Θεοῦ φεῦγε ταῦτα δὲ δίωκε δικαιοσύνην εὐσέβειαν πίστιν ἀγάπην ὑπομονήν πραϋπαθίαν
verses.transliteration: de Sy ō anthrōpe Theou pheuge tauta de diōke dikaiosynēn eusebeian pistin agapēn hypomonēn praupathian
verses.literal: But you O man of God flee from these things and pursue righteousness godliness faith love perseverance [and] gentleness

verses.original: ἀγωνίζου τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα τῆς πίστεως ἐπιλαβοῦ τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς εἰς ἣν ἐκλήθης καὶ ὡμολόγησας τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν ἐνώπιον πολλῶν μαρτύρων
verses.transliteration: agōnizou ton kalon agōna tēs pisteōs epilabou tēs aiōniou zōēs eis hēn eklēthēs kai hōmologēsas tēn kalēn homologian enōpion pollōn martyrōn
verses.literal: Fight the good fight of the faith Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called vvv [when you made] the good confession before many witnesses

verses.original: Παραγγέλλω σοι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ζωογονοῦντος τὰ πάντα καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν μαρτυρήσαντος ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου
verses.transliteration: Parangellō soi enōpion tou Theou tou zōogonountos ta panta kai Christou Iēsou tou tēn kalēn homologian martyrēsantos epi Pontiou Pilatou
verses.literal: I charge you in the presence - of God who gives life to all things and of Christ Jesus who {made} the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate

verses.original: τηρῆσαί σε τὴν ἐντολὴν ἄσπιλον ἀνεπίλημπτον μέχρι τῆς ἐπιφανείας ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: tērēsai se tēn entolēn aspilon anepilēmpton mechri tēs epiphaneias hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Keep . . . [this] commandment without stain [or] reproach until the appearance of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ἣν ὁ μακάριος καὶ μόνος Δυνάστης ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν βασιλευόντων καὶ Κύριος τῶν κυριευόντων δείξει ἰδίοις καιροῖς
verses.transliteration: hēn ho makarios kai monos Dynastēs ho Basileus tōn basileuontōn kai Kyrios tōn kyrieuontōn deixei idiois kairois
verses.literal: which the blessed and only Sovereign [One] the King of kings and Lord of lords will bring about in His own time

verses.original: ὁ μόνος ἔχων ἀθανασίαν οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον φῶς οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων εἶδεν ὃν οὐδὲ δύναται ἰδεῖν ᾧ τιμὴ καὶ αἰώνιον κράτος ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: ho monos echōn athanasian oikōn aprositon phōs oudeis anthrōpōn eiden hon oude dynatai idein hō timē kai aiōnion kratos amēn
verses.literal: [He] alone is immortal [and] dwells in unapproachable light No one - has ever seen [Him] nor can [anyone] see [Him] To [Him be] honor and eternal dominion Amen

verses.original: παράγγελλε Τοῖς πλουσίοις ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι μὴ ὑψηλοφρονεῖν μηδὲ ἠλπικέναι ἐπὶ ἀδηλότητι πλούτου ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ Θεῷ τῷ πλουσίως παρέχοντι πάντα ἡμῖν εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν
verses.transliteration: parangelle Tois plousiois en tō nyn aiōni mē hypsēlophronein mēde ēlpikenai epi adēlotēti ploutou all’ epi Theō tō plousiōs parechonti panta hēmin eis apolausin
verses.literal: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited [and] not to put their hope in [the] uncertainty of wealth but in God who richly provides all things for us to enjoy

verses.original: ἀγαθοεργεῖν πλουτεῖν ἐν καλοῖς ἔργοις εἶναι εὐμεταδότους κοινωνικούς
verses.transliteration: agathoergein ploutein en kalois ergois einai eumetadotous koinōnikous
verses.literal: [Instruct them] to do good to be rich in good works [and] to be generous [and] ready to share

verses.original: ἀποθησαυρίζοντας ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν θεμέλιον εἰς τὸ μέλλον ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται τῆς ὄντως ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: apothēsaurizontas heautois kalon themelion eis to mellon hina epilabōntai tēs ontōs zōēs
verses.literal: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future so that they may take hold of that which is truly life

verses.original: Ὦ Τιμόθεε φύλαξον τὴν παραθήκην ἐκτρεπόμενος τὰς βεβήλους κενοφωνίας καὶ ἀντιθέσεις τῆς ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως
verses.transliteration: Ō Timothee phylaxon tēn parathēkēn ektrepomenos tas bebēlous kenophōnias kai antitheseis tēs pseudōnymou gnōseōs
verses.literal: O Timothy guard what has been entrusted [to you] Avoid - irreverent empty chatter and the opposing arguments - of so-called knowledge

verses.original: ἥν τινες ἐπαγγελλόμενοι ἠστόχησαν περὶ τὴν πίστιν Ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hēn tines epangellomenoi ēstochēsan peri tēn pistin Hē charis meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: which some have professed and [thus] swerved away from the faith - Grace [be] with you all
